variant: Wrap tagpdf private finish function, then clear ltx.__tag mc/struct/tables/page mirrors and collect Lua garbage.
method: One direct tagged LuaLaTeX pass; same generated source template and auxiliary seed as the memory factorial; RSS sampled each second; full PDF audit afterward.

interpretation.finding: The Lua heap fell substantially after tagpdf finished writing the structure tree. The candidate PDF passed the exact audit: 1,096 pages, all 24,126 link OBJR/ParentTree owners, 400 accessible figures, and matching text and link hashes.
interpretation.limitation: This is one candidate and one baseline. The 44.50 MiB lower RSS peak is within the observed run-to-run variation; the data does not yet establish a stable peak-RSS reduction.
interpretation.decision: Do not integrate this private-API cleanup yet. It needs repeated paired runs and a memory-sampling trace around finalization; no production code changed.
